stock.description: Legion Consortium Limited operates as a logistics provider in Singapore, offering a full range of services such as trucking, freight forwarding, and specialized transport solutions. Its operational assets, as of December 31, 2021, included a fleet of 49 prime movers, 466 trailers, 2 flat vans, 2 reach stackers, and 3 forklifts. The company also engages in business growth and development ventures. Established in 1995, Legion Consortium Limited maintains its headquarters in Singapore.
